environment: python3 branches.py from a clean git worktree of sdlc/S-006, node 24 cli-runner with scratch HOME and TZ=UTC; no network

cases.title: CLI name equals Python name for all 24 kind and format cases
cases.given: A scratch git repo and the real branches.py
cases.when: Run `branches.py name --format F --kind K ...` for 8 kinds x 3 formats
cases.then: branch equals mod.name; prefix, suffix and tail match; git check-ref-format passes; exit 0; stderr empty; tree unchanged
cases.expected: branch equals mod.name; prefix, suffix and tail match; git check-ref-format passes; exit 0; stderr empty; tree unchanged
cases.actual: 24 of 24 cases matched (state compared by shape because its stamp is the clock)
